notes: ACCESS: laredoute.co.uk still returns the Cloudflare 'Country challenge' 403 to plain requests and to a curl_cffi sweep (chrome124, chrome131, edge101, safari17_0, safari18_0_ios all 403), and r.jina.ai returns the 'Just a moment...' captcha shell. NEW WORKING ROUTE the prior Home-Decor pass did not find: a plain requests GET with a Googlebot User-Agent returns the full unmodified origin HTML (HTTP 200, ~900KB) on every /pplp/ listing page; Bingbot UA works too. robots.txt (200) contains no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web directive and does not disallow /pplp/. All rows here come from that raw HTML; WebFetch was used only for the first nav reconnaissance. DOMAIN/SCOPE: this is the laredoute.co.uk UK storefront, UNFILTERED - the whole marketplace across all brands, i.e. the SR 82 scope. No brndid parameter was applied to any URL, so this is NOT the ?brndid=la-redoute-interieurs house-brand subset that SR 278 (La Redoute Interiors UK, same domain) covers, and not laredoute.fr (SR 98). Any SR 278 furniture figures should be strictly smaller subsets of the numbers below. TREE: rebuilt from the site's own data. Each /pplp/ page embeds a JSON blob with "BreadCrumbDetail" and "Breadcrumb" giving the node's full ancestor chain of category ids, plus a 'featuredCarousel' of related category links. 375 category pages were crawled starting from Furniture (id 75363), Sofas & Armchairs (385993), Tables & Chairs (385998), Bedroom & Bedding (75326), Garden (75067), Office Furniture (75392), Bathroom Furniture (75495), Kids (75416), Nursery (75526), Storage (393808), Hallway (392592) and every 'Shop by room' landing page; the true parent/child tree was then rebuilt from the breadcrumb id chains, because the carousels mix children with siblings and uncles and cannot be trusted for parentage. QTY METHOD: every qty is the rendered listing header - the <span id="ProductCount"> that sits immediately to the right of the page H1 - cross-checked against data-totalproduct on the product-grid container; the two agreed on all 91 nodes read. SANITY CHECKS: all 73 leaves were fetched a SECOND time with a forced cache bypass and all 73 counts were identical (no drift); counts differ per category so there is no constant site-wide number; no suspiciously round display caps; and each page's embedded breadcrumb was checked to confirm the server served the node actually requested (several SEO H1s differ from the node name - e.g. id 75399 'Ready Made Sofas' renders H1 'Sofas' - and the breadcrumb 'Sofas & Armchairs > Sofas > Ready Made Sofas' is what confirms identity). HIERARCHY: parents with extractable children are emitted as grouping rows only; their own totals were read but deliberately not reused as leaf qty (Sofas & Armchairs 398, Sofas 159, Armchairs 184, Tables 253, Dining Chairs & Stools 236, Benches & Storage Benches 70, Sideboards Cabinets & Dressers 189, TV Stands & Audio Units 93, Wardrobes & Clothes Storage 328, Bedroom Storage Furniture 158, Office Furniture 243, Bathroom Furniture 79, Beds 257, Kids Beds 67, Cots & Travel Cots 17). EXCLUDED and why: Mattresses 150 and all its children, Bed Bases & Valances, Duvets, Pillows, Toppers & Protectors and all Bed Linen (bedding, not furniture); Seat Pads 7 and Garden Furniture Covers 64 (textiles/covers); Towel Rails 10, Bathroom Accessories, Toilet Accessories, Bathroom Bins and Laundry Baskets (bathroom fixtures and accessories); Office Storage Accessories 41 (desk-tidy organisers); Clothes Hangers & Organisers 15 and Clothes Bags & Covers 22 (accessories); Coat Hooks & Racks 63, Baskets & Boxes 221, Storage Trunks & Chests 36, Toy Boxes 32, Umbrella Stands 1, Room Dividers & Screens 4 and the rest of the 'Storage Decor' branch (standalone storage goods, reserved for the Storage task); Outdoor Storage 12 including Storage Boxes & Units 7 and Log Storage 1; Garden Shelving 2 (both listed items are the same iron planter console/plant stand, not shelving); Garden Screens & Trellis 1, Garden Trolleys 2, Parasols & Parasol Stands 15, Barbeque 12, Firepits 16 (garden equipment); Highchairs 7 (4 of the 7 items are highchair trays, so the node is majority accessories and was dropped rather than reported as kids furniture); 'Small gardens & balconies' 56 (curated cross-category roll-up, never-extract list); every 'New In ...' node, Best Sellers, Outlet and Sale; and the entire Lighting, Rugs & Runners, Home Accessories & Decor, Wall Art & Wallpaper, Mirrors, Home Furnishings & Textiles, Tableware, Electricals & Cookware and Fashion departments. OVERLAP WARNING for the merge: under Sofas and under Armchairs the site publishes BOTH a lead-time split (Ready Made / Made To Order) and a type split (Corner Sofas / Sofa Beds / Modular Sofas; Rocking Chairs) as sibling nav categories, so those leaves overlap one another - flagged on the four lead-time rows. The same pattern exists under Tables (Dining Tables 230 vs Extendable Dining Tables 71) and under Beds (Single/Double-King vs Storage Beds).
